title: The Classic of the Petty Man — Xiao Ren Jing (English)
summary: A complete English translation of the Xiao Ren Jing, also called the Mirror of Rise and Fall, in ten scrolls: a handbook of the petty man ascribed to Feng Dao, chief minister to four of the Five Dynasties houses. The histories record the man; no bibliography records the book, and the text translated here was written under his name in modern times. The case is set out on the page.
